themes.name: Push notification controls
themes.description: Notifications and alerts from the app, including the inability to turn them off or customize them, their frequency and content, and having to dismiss them manually after opening.

themes.name: Live stream reliability
themes.description: Whether live radio and station streams connect, play continuously and stay connected, including endless buffering, spinning or connecting screens, dropouts, and errors such as 'can't play this media'.

themes.name: Playback skipping and position
themes.description: Podcast and story playback that skips, repeats, restarts, starts mid-story or loses the listener's place, and the ability to seek or fast forward within an item.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: How the playlist or queue behaves, including playlists being cleared or deleted, adding and managing stories, and playing whole programs rather than individual segments.

themes.name: Crashes and device compatibility
themes.description: App crashes, freezes, force closes, and problems tied to specific devices or OS updates, such as lock screen glitches, Android version incompatibilities and failure to open.

themes.name: Background running and battery
themes.description: The app running in the background or starting by itself, battery and data drain, memory use, and the lack of a way to quit or shut it down.

themes.name: Tablet and landscape orientation
themes.description: Support for landscape or auto-rotate mode and use of the app on tablets.

themes.name: Visual design and interface
themes.description: The look, layout, and ease of navigation of the app, including dated appearance, clunky or intuitive navigation, and display of menus and screens.

themes.name: Ads and popups
themes.description: Banner ads, pop-up ads and ads that block content or cannot be closed, as well as sponsor messages in audio.

themes.name: Offline listening and downloads
themes.description: Wanting or lacking the ability to download audio, podcasts or articles for offline use and for areas without a connection.

themes.name: Chromecast and external controls
themes.description: Casting support such as Chromecast and controls from outside the app, including lock screen and notification media controls, widgets and Bluetooth.

themes.name: Local station access
themes.description: Finding, saving and streaming local and member stations across the country, including stations missing or disappearing from the list.

themes.name: Hourly news and program availability
themes.description: Availability and freshness of the hourly newscast and specific programs or episodes, including missing shows, delayed updates and archive access.

themes.name: Article display and media
themes.description: How articles render in the app, including images, charts, text overlap, missing links, font size and text settings, and reading features.

themes.name: SD card installation
themes.description: Requests or complaints about moving the app to the SD card or its internal storage footprint.

themes.name: News content and bias
themes.description: Opinions on the quality, trustworthiness, and political leaning of NPR's reporting and coverage.
